rows.en:
We will now hold the practical test.
I'm sure some of you are nervous, but if you
do what you always do, you'll be fine.

Even if you get a failing grade,
it's not as if there's any punishment.
(Then I guess I can relax...)

Heh, all that awaits you is remedial lessons
with me. If anything, that's more like a reward.

I've gotta work hard so I don't fail...!)

Are you ready, \p?
